FAQ

Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you need to know about bathroom floor tile installation in Brooklyn and NYC.

Bathroom floor tile installation in Brooklyn typically costs $800–$3,500 depending on bathroom size, tile material, and layout complexity. Ceramic tile is most affordable, while natural stone and large-format porcelain cost more. We offer free estimates with transparent pricing — no hidden fees.

Most bathroom floor tile installations take 1–3 days depending on the size of the space and tile type. This includes old floor removal, waterproofing, tile setting, and grouting. Complex patterns like herringbone may take an additional day.

Porcelain tile is the most popular choice for NYC apartments — waterproof, durable, and available in hundreds of styles. Ceramic is budget-friendly, natural stone adds luxury, and large-format tiles (24×24) can make small bathrooms feel much larger.

You don't need to leave your home, but the bathroom will be out of use for 1–2 days during installation, plus an additional 24 hours while grout cures. Our team works efficiently to minimize disruption to your daily routine.

Yes — old flooring removal and disposal is included in our tile installation service. We also inspect and repair the subfloor before installation to ensure a perfectly level, stable surface for your new tiles.

Yes. Sani Building Corp is fully licensed and insured to perform tile installation and renovation work throughout New York City including Brooklyn, Manhattan, Queens, Bronx, Staten Island, and Long Island.

We install all sizes from small mosaic and hex patterns to large-format 24×48 tiles. We also specialize in herringbone, chevron, diagonal, and custom pattern layouts. Our team will recommend the best size and pattern for your bathroom dimensions.

We serve all NYC boroughs — Brooklyn, Manhattan, Queens, Bronx, Staten Island, and Long Island. Brooklyn neighborhoods include Park Slope, Williamsburg, Bay Ridge, Brooklyn Heights, Bensonhurst, Flatbush, Sunset Park, Crown Heights, and Coney Island. Same-day response available. Call 332-277-0990.
